# Foundry Design System Packages

Prebuilt tarballs of Foundry, the author's own design-system packages (`@foundry/ui`, `@foundry/charts`, `@foundry/tokens`):

- `@foundry/charts`: `foundry-charts-0.1.22.tgz` (v0.1.22)
- `@foundry/tokens`: `foundry-tokens-0.1.10.tgz` (v0.1.10)
- `@foundry/ui`: `foundry-ui-0.1.23.tgz` (v0.1.23)

These packages are vendored so Phalanx builds without an external package registry. They are covered by the repository's Apache-2.0 LICENSE and are not yet published to npm.
